## Rasio Eosinofil per Limfosit dan Rasio Basofil per Limfosit pada reaksi anafilaksis

## Library

```{r}

#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(googlesheets4)
library(skimr)
library(gtsummary)
library(skimr)
library(flextable)
library(car)
library(broom)
library(pROC)
```

### Seleksi Data

```{r}
#| label: Data selection
#| include: false
data_awal <- read_csv("data_awal.csv")
data_clean <- data_awal %>%
  filter(inc_exc == "Include") %>%
  mutate(across(20:30, as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(Gender = as.factor(Gender)) %>%
  mutate(MR = as.character(MR)) %>%
  mutate(Onset_jam = as.numeric(Onset_jam)) %>%
  mutate(Usia = as.numeric(Usia)) %>%
  mutate(Skin = map_chr(Skin, toString)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(5,9,10,15,16,17,18,19), as.factor))
  
data_clean <- data_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # 1. Rasio Berbasis Leukosit
    NLR = Ne / Ly,
    MLR = Mo / Ly,
    BLR = Ba / Ly,
    ELR = Eo / Ly,
    ENR = Eo / Ne,
    
    # 2. Tambahan: Rasio Spesifik Seluler
    EMR = Eo / Mo,
    BER = Ba / Eo,
    
    # 3. Rasio Berbasis Trombosit
    PLR = PLT / Ly,
    MPR = MPV / PLT,
    MPVLR = MPV / Ly,
    
    # 3. Indeks Inflamasi Sistemik Komposit
    SII = (PLT * Ne) / Ly,
    SIRI = (Ne * Mo) / Ly,
    
    # Tambahan: Aggregate Index of Systemic Inflammation
    AISI = (Ne * PLT * Mo) / Ly,
    
    # --- 4. Rasio Berbasis Hemoglobin ---
    HPR = HGB / PLT
  )

glimpse(data_clean)
```

```{r}
# 3. Membuat Tabel Karakteristik (Tabel 1)
tabel_publikasi <- data_clean %>%

  # Membangun tabel dasar gtsummary
  tbl_summary(
    by = Alergy_Dx, # Memisahkan kolom berdasarkan Gender (Laki-laki vs Perempuan)

      all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})", # Format Median (IQR) untuk numerik
```

### Usia

```{r}
data_clean %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Usia, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Usia, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(Usia, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q1 = quantile(Usia, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(Usia, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min = min(Usia),
    Max = max(Usia),
  )

ggplot(data_clean, aes(x = Usia)) +
  # Membuat histogram (y diatur sebagai densitas agar sejajar dengan kurva normal)
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.6) +
  
  # Membuat garis kurva dari data aktual
  geom_density(color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  
  # Menambahkan garis kurva normal ideal (putus-putus) sebagai pembanding
  stat_function(
    fun = dnorm,
    args = list(mean = mean(data_clean$Usia, na.rm = TRUE), sd = sd(data_clean$Usia, na.rm = TRUE)),
    color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribusi Nilai Usia dengan Kurva Normal",
    x = "Usia", 
    y = "Densitas"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Melihat Distribusi

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# 1. Pilih variabel numerik yang ingin dianalisis (misal: lab darah)
# Anda bisa menambahkan atau mengurangi variabel di sini
variabel_lab <- c("Usia", "Onset_jam", "WBC", "Ne", "Ly", "Eo", "Ba", "HGB", "PLT", "MPV", "NLR", "MLR", "BLR", "ELR", "ENR","BER", "EMR", "PLR", "MPR", "MPVLR", "SII", "SIRI", "AISI","HPR")

variabel_proses <- c("Usia", "Onset_jam", "WBC", "Ne", "Ly", "Eo", "Ba", "HGB", "PLT", "MPV", "NLR", "MLR", "BLR", "ELR", "ENR", "EMR", "PLR", "MPR", "MPVLR", "SII", "SIRI", "AISI","HPR")

# 2. Membuat Dataframe untuk Label Statistik
# Kita loop setiap variabel untuk menghitung p-value
stats_labels <- map_dfr(variabel_proses, function(var) {
  
  # Shapiro-Wilk (untuk keseluruhan data)
  p_shap <- shapiro.test(data_clean[[var]])$p.value
  
  # Levene Test (berdasarkan Gender)
  f <- as.formula(paste(var, "~ Alergy_Dx"))
  p_lev <- leveneTest(f, data = data_clean)$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  
  # Membuat string label
  label_text <- paste0("Shapiro p: ", round(p_shap, 3), 
                       "\nLevene p: ", round(p_lev, 3))
  
  return(data.frame(Parameter = var, label = label_text))
})

# 4. Transformasi data ke format 'long' agar ggplot bisa membaca banyak variabel
data_clean_long <- data_clean %>%
  select(Alergy_Dx, all_of(variabel_lab)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Alergy_Dx, names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "Nilai")

# 5. Membuat Plot
Distribusi_violin <- ggplot(data_clean_long, aes(x = Alergy_Dx, y = Nilai, fill = Alergy_Dx)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5) +          # Bagian violin untuk melihat sebaran
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) + # Bagian boxplot untuk melihat median
  geom_text(data = stats_labels, 
            aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = label), # x=1.5 (tengah), y=Inf (paling atas)
            vjust = 1.5, size = 3, color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~Parameter, scales = "free_y") + # Pisahkan per parameter
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribusi Parameter Laboratorium Berdasarkan Gender",
    subtitle = "Visualisasi untuk menilai asumsi normalitas & varians",
    x = "Diagnosis Alergi",
    y = "Nilai Parameter"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

Distribusi_violin
```
```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# LANGKAH 1: Persiapan Data (Binarisasi Outcome)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Kurva ROC membutuhkan variabel dependen (Y) yang bersifat biner (0 dan 1).
# Kita jadikan Hipersensitivitas = 0 (Kontrol), Anafilaksis & Syok = 1 (Kasus)

data_roc <- data_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # Buat kolom baru bernama 'keparahan_biner'
    keparahan_biner = ifelse(Alergy_Dx == "Reaksi_hipersensitivitas", 0, 1)
  )

# LANGKAH 2: Menjalankan Analisis ROC
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Catatan: Karena MLR semakin RENDAH pada kasus yang BERAT, 
# pROC secara otomatis akan mendeteksi arah ini (direction = ">").

roc_mlr <- roc(response = data_roc$keparahan_biner, 
               predictor = data_roc$MLR)


# LANGKAH 3: Melihat Hasil AUC dan Confidence Interval
# ---------------------------------------------------------
print("=== NILAI AREA UNDER THE CURVE (AUC) ===")
print(roc_mlr)
print(ci.auc(roc_mlr)) # Menampilkan 95% Confidence Interval untuk AUC


# LANGKAH 4: Mencari Cut-off Optimal (Youden Index)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Youden Index akan mencari titik yang memaksimalkan Sensitivitas + Spesifisitas
best_cutoff <- coords(roc_mlr, 
                      x = "best", 
                      best.method = "youden",
                      ret = c("threshold", "specificity", "sensitivity", "accuracy"))

print("=== NILAI CUT-OFF OPTIMAL MLR ===")
print(best_cutoff)

# LANGKAH 5: Membuat Visualisasi Kurva ROC Siap Publikasi
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Plot ini bisa langsung diekspor untuk naskah jurnal (Resolusi tinggi)
plot(roc_mlr,
     main = "Kurva ROC: Nilai MLR sebagai Prediktor Anafilaksis",
     col = "#2c3e50",          # Warna garis (biru gelap)
     lwd = 3,                  # Ketebalan garis
     legacy.axes = TRUE,       # Sumbu X menampilkan "1 - Specificity" (FPR)
     print.auc = TRUE,         # Mencetak nilai AUC langsung di grafik
     print.auc.y = 0.3,        # Posisi teks AUC
     print.thres = "best",     # Menandai titik cut-off terbaik di grafik
     print.thres.pch = 19,     # Bentuk titik cut-off (bulat solid)
     print.thres.col = "red",  # Warna titik cut-off
     print.thres.cex = 1.2)    # Ukuran teks cut-off
```

```{r}
# 1. Ekstrak Data untuk Anotasi
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Mengambil nilai AUC dan 95% Confidence Interval
auc_val <- round(auc(roc_mlr), 3)
ci_val <- ci(roc_mlr)
ci_low <- round(ci_val[1], 3)
ci_high <- round(ci_val[3], 3)

# Mengambil titik cut-off terbaik (Youden Index) untuk Opsi Spesifisitas Tinggi
# (Rekomendasi cut-off <= 0.172 yang sejalan dengan median syok)
best_coords <- coords(roc_mlr, x = 0.1721377, input = "threshold",
                      ret = c("threshold", "specificity", "sensitivity"))

# 2. Membuat Kurva dengan ggplot2 (ggroc)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
roc_plot <- ggroc(roc_mlr, 
                  colour = "#4e79a7", # Warna biru kalem khas jurnal (Tableau palette)
                  linewidth = 1.2) +  # Menggunakan linewidth pengganti size untuk garis
  
  # Garis referensi diagonal (warna abu-abu kalem)
  geom_abline(intercept = 1, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "#AAB7B8", linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  # Titik poin untuk nilai cut-off optimal
  geom_point(aes(x = best_coords$specificity, y = best_coords$sensitivity),
             color = "#e15759", # Merah bata/kalem 
             size = 3.5, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 1.5) +
  
  # Teks anotasi untuk Cut-off
  annotate("text", 
           x = best_coords$specificity - 0.08, # Menggeser posisi teks agar tidak menabrak garis
           y = best_coords$sensitivity + 0.05,
           label = paste0("Cut-off \u2264 ", round(best_coords$threshold, 3)),
           size = 4.5, color = "#c13b3e", fontface = "bold.italic") +
  
  # Teks anotasi untuk AUC & 95% CI (diletakkan di area kanan bawah)
  annotate("text", 
           x = 0.35, y = 0.15,
           label = paste0("AUC = ", auc_val, "\n95% CI (", ci_low, " - ", ci_high, ")"),
           size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = "#2C3E50") +
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Kustomisasi Tema (Estetika Minimalis & Elegan)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) + # Tema bersih tanpa background abu-abu
  labs(
    x = "Spesifisitas",
    y = "Sensitivitas"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#34495E", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#34495E", margin = margin(r = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#566573"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "#BDC3C7", linewidth = 0.8),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#F2F3F4", linetype = "dotted"), # Grid tipis
    plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
  ) +
  # Membalik sumbu X dari 1.0 ke 0.0 (Standar baku kurva ROC kedokteran)
  scale_x_reverse(limits = c(1, 0), breaks = seq(1, 0, by = -0.2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2))

# Tampilkan Plot
print(roc_plot)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Ekspor Gambar Resolusi Tinggi (300 DPI) untuk Jurnal
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Ganti path folder sesuai dengan komputer Anda
ggsave("Kurva_ROC_MLR_Estetik.tiff", 
       plot = roc_plot, 
       width = 6, height = 6, units = "in", 
       dpi = 300, 
       compression = "lzw")
```

```{r}
# Pastikan library sudah dimuat
library(pROC)
library(ggplot2)

# Asumsi: Objek 'roc_mlr' sudah dibuat sebelumnya dari fungsi roc()
# roc_mlr <- roc(response = data_roc$keparahan_biner, predictor = data_roc$MLR)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Ekstrak Titik Cut-off dari Hasil pROC
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Opsi 1: Cut-off Skrining (Sensitivitas Tinggi) -> MLR <= 0.438
c_sens <- coords(roc_mlr, x = 0.4387298, input = "threshold",
                 ret = c("threshold", "specificity", "sensitivity"))

# Opsi 2: Cut-off Konfirmasi Syok (Spesifisitas Tinggi) -> MLR <= 0.172
c_spec <- coords(roc_mlr, x = 0.1721377, input = "threshold",
                 ret = c("threshold", "specificity", "sensitivity"))

# Buat dataframe khusus titik penanda untuk memicu Legend otomatis
df_cutoffs <- data.frame(
  Kategori = c("Skrining (Sensitivitas Tinggi)", "Konfirmasi (Spesifisitas Tinggi)"),
  Threshold = c(c_sens$threshold, c_spec$threshold),
  Specificity = c(c_sens$specificity, c_spec$specificity),
  Sensitivity = c(c_sens$sensitivity, c_spec$sensitivity)
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Ekstrak Nilai AUC dan 95% CI
# ---------------------------------------------------------
auc_val <- round(auc(roc_mlr), 3)
ci_val <- ci(roc_mlr)
ci_text <- paste0("AUC = ", auc_val, "\n95% CI: ", round(ci_val[1], 3), " - ", round(ci_val[3], 3))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Plot Kurva ROC Estetik dengan Dual Anotasi & Legend
# ---------------------------------------------------------
roc_plot <- ggroc(roc_mlr, colour = "#4e79a7", linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  # Garis referensi diagonal (menebak 50% / kebetulan)
  geom_abline(intercept = 1, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "#AAB7B8", linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  # Titik Penanda Cut-off (Memicu Legend di ggplot)
  geom_point(data = df_cutoffs, 
             aes(x = Specificity, y = Sensitivity, fill = Kategori, shape = Kategori),
             size = 4, stroke = 1.1, color = "#2C3E50") +
  
  # --- Anotasi Teks 1: Cut-off Skrining (MLR <= 0.438) ---
  # Posisi x dikurangi (geser kanan di grafik terbalik) agar label terbaca jelas
  annotate("text", 
           x = df_cutoffs$Specificity[1] + 0.1, 
           y = df_cutoffs$Sensitivity[1] + 0.12,
           label = paste0("MLR \u2264 ", round(df_cutoffs$Threshold[1], 3), 
                          "\nSens: ", round(df_cutoffs$Sensitivity[1]*100, 1), 
                          "%\nSpes: ", round(df_cutoffs$Specificity[1]*100, 1), "%"),
           size = 3.6, color = "#f28e2b", fontface = "bold", hjust = 0) +
  
  # --- Anotasi Teks 2: Cut-off Konfirmasi Syok (MLR <= 0.172) ---
  # Posisi x ditambah (geser kiri di grafik terbalik) 
  annotate("text", 
           x = df_cutoffs$Specificity[2] - 0.075, 
           y = df_cutoffs$Sensitivity[2] + 0.12,
           label = paste0("MLR \u2264 ", round(df_cutoffs$Threshold[2], 3), 
                          "\nSens: ", round(df_cutoffs$Sensitivity[2]*100, 1), 
                          "%\nSpes: ", round(df_cutoffs$Specificity[2]*100, 1), "%"),
           size = 3.6, color = "#e15759", fontface = "bold", hjust = 1) +

  # --- Anotasi Teks 3: AUC & CI ---
  # Diletakkan di tengah bawah grafik
  annotate("text", x = 0.27, y = 0.06, label = ci_text, size = 4.5, fontface = "bold", color = "#2C3E50") +
  
  # Kustomisasi Bentuk & Warna Titik Legend
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Skrining (Sensitivitas Tinggi)" = "#f28e2b", # Oranye
                               "Konfirmasi (Spesifisitas Tinggi)" = "#e15759")) + # Merah
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Skrining (Sensitivitas Tinggi)" = 21,  # Lingkaran
                                "Konfirmasi (Spesifisitas Tinggi)" = 24)) + # Segitiga
  
  # Pengaturan Sumbu Terbalik (Spesifisitas 1.0 ke 0.0)
  scale_x_reverse(limits = c(1.05, -0.05), breaks = seq(1, 0, by = -0.2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.05, 1.05), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
  
  # Tema Kebersihan & Tata Letak
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    x = "Spesifisitas",
    y = "Sensitivitas",
    fill = "Ambang Batas (Cut-off):",
    shape = "Ambang Batas (Cut-off):"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#34495E", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#34495E", margin = margin(r = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#566573"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "#BDC3C7", linewidth = 0.8),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#F2F3F4", linetype = "dotted"),
    
    # Pengaturan Posisi dan Desain Kotak Legend di Area Kosong
    legend.position = c(0.7, 0.35),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.9), color = "#BDC3C7", linewidth = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", color = "#2C3E50"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9, color = "#34495E"),
    legend.margin = margin(6, 8, 6, 8),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
  )

# Tampilkan Plot
print(roc_plot)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Simpan Gambar ke Format TIFF 300 DPI
# ---------------------------------------------------------
ggsave("Kurva_ROC_MLR_Dual_0438_0172.tiff", 
       plot = roc_plot, 
       width = 6.5, height = 6, units = "in", 
       dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
```
